title: Cover cached evidence replay while a verdict submission is in flight
outcome: Verify that both successful replay caches share the existing operation guard with submission and release their lease when replay completes. Document the conflict in the evidence recovery contract if helpful.
acceptance: While an evaluator verdict submission holds the operation guard, repeating an already successful selected and catalog readKey returns an in-progress conflict and exposes no cached evidence.
Once that operation is released, both identical readKey replays succeed with their original response, and a subsequent submission can acquire the guard.
